resources.string: TrailVeil
TRAILVEIL
Reveal the trail as you walk
Start an exploration to record a precise trail, including while your screen is locked.
Before your first exploration
Your trail stays on this device
TrailVeil stores location history locally and does not upload your route. The online basemap comes from the third-party provider named below, which receives requests for the map area being viewed.
Active basemap: %1$s
Stored explorations exist only inside this app. Uninstalling TrailVeil permanently deletes them, and there is no backup or cloud copy to restore.
Precise location is required for a useful track. Notification access keeps the active recording visible, but declining it will not prevent recording.
Start exploration
Stop exploration
Starting…
Permissions are requested only after you press Start exploration. No location is collected before then.
Got it
Exploration menu
Privacy and data
Interactive exploration map
Location is needed to draw your trail
Allow location while using TrailVeil so an exploration can continue through a foreground service after the screen is locked.
Location permission is turned off
Android will no longer show the permission prompt. Open TrailVeil’s app settings and allow precise location, then return and press Start again.
Choose precise location
Approximate location cannot produce a reliable walking trail. Android can ask once more for precise access.
Precise location is still off
Open TrailVeil’s app settings, enable precise location, then return and press Start again.
Device location is off
Turn on device location in Android Settings, then return and press Start again.
Recording works, but its notification is hidden
TrailVeil can still record through a foreground service. Enable notifications if you want the persistent recording status and Stop action in the notification drawer.
Recording paused while the app was closed

It resumed when you reopened TrailVeil. Some devices need TrailVeil’s battery restriction and background-start settings adjusted before the system will bring a recording back on its own. Vendors name and place these differently; if your device has no such options, nothing needs changing. Either way, TrailVeil records location only after you press Start exploration.
